supplementalBreakdowns.basis: SHEEO's current Grapevine download reports revised FY2024 state support collected primarily from state finance and budget officers. The $529,487,468 public four-year operating line is net of agency funding, state aid, and research/agriculture/medical support; it is a state budget-support ceiling—not each institution's all-funds adopted budget. State support excludes capital outlays/debt service, federal funds, tuition/fees, and auxiliaries. Use rows reproduce $906,252,431 of state support.
